license_required.quote: A person may not engage in the business of money transmission

bond_structure.quote: in an amount based on the previous year's money transmission dollar volume
bond_structure.note: Volume-based, but the schedule is set by rule within $10,000 to $550,000; director may raise to $1,000,000. Judgment call: could be argued formula.

bond_min_usd.quote: The minimum surety bond must be at least ten thousand dollars

bond_max_usd.quote: The director may increase the amount of the bond required up to a maximum of one million dollars
bond_max_usd.note: Normal cap is $550,000 in (1); $1,000,000 in (6) is the highest stated. Judgment call.

net_worth_structure.quote: as determined in rule by the director. The director shall require a tangible net worth of at least ten thousand dollars
net_worth_structure.note: Rule sets the amount between $10,000 and $3,000,000

net_worth_min_usd.quote: The director shall require a tangible net worth of at least ten thousand dollars

application_fee_usd.quote: A application fee of one thousand dollars
application_fee_usd.note: Statute 19.230.040(3) leaves the amount to rule; 'A application' is the rule's own wording

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The total minimum assessment must be one thousand dollars per year
renewal_fee_usd.note: No renewal: licenses have no fixed expiration (19.230.070(4)). Annual assessment minimum used, as with California's annual fee. Judgment call.

decision_days.quote: The director may for good cause extend the application review period
decision_days.note: 19.230.070(2) lets the director extend the review period but sets no approve-or-deny deadline

exemptions.quote: This chapter does not apply to:
exemptions.note: Director's discretionary waiver paragraph (unnumbered) not counted. Tag calls to review: (8) clearing agency, (12) closed-loop prepaid, (14) insured prepaid, (16) bookkeeping.
